composition: Etruscan hilltop ruins overlooking the Gulf of Baratti · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the ruined acropolis, the camera looks out over the Gulf of Baratti in the bright 11:58 midday sun. Crumbling Etruscan stone walls and a broken tower fill the left foreground, while dark green pine forest falls away at center toward the curving sandy beach and the turquoise water of the gulf. The distant headland stretches along the left horizon under a clear pale-blue sky, the sea glittering in the high daylight.
